title: Selected ventures
intro: I build things where human growth, imagination and craft meet. Some are digital homes for people and their ideas; some are worlds, scents and keepsakes you can hold; some are places to heal. This is a selection of the ventures I'm shaping now.

projects.title: YOU
projects.description: A human development and community ecosystem: personal growth, community, guided journeys, events, a marketplace and gamification.
projects.portfolioDescription: A home for growing, together. YOU brings personal development and community into one place: guided journeys to follow at your own pace, events to meet in person, a marketplace for people who help others grow, and a playful layer that notices progress and makes it feel worth celebrating.

projects.title: YOUrigin
projects.description: A personal creative operating environment for ideas, writing, lyrics, research, Projects and Works.
projects.portfolioDescription: A personal creative operating environment. YOUrigin gives ideas, writing, lyrics and research somewhere to land the moment they arrive, then helps them grow into Projects and finished Works. It is private by design, works offline, and keeps a whole creative life in one calm place.

projects.title: CommYOUnity
projects.description: A small app for the people living and working at Terra Sangha, an eight-hectare community on the land in Portugal.
projects.portfolioDescription: A shared home, in an app, for the people living and working at Terra Sangha, an eight-hectare community on the land in Portugal. CommYOUnity brings together community tasks and rotas, shared expenses, a calendar of arrivals and gatherings, a noticeboard, and GratitYOUde, a simple way to thank one another.

projects.title: Wandering
projects.description: A modern explorer's atlas: a private map of your travels and plans, and an easy way to meet up with friends when you choose.
projects.portfolioDescription:
Wandering is a modern explorer's atlas. It keeps a private map of where you've been, where you dream of going and the journeys you're planning: places, Moments with photos, expeditions, routes that follow the curve of the Earth, and journeys recorded as you walk, ride or drive, even with the screen off. Social Wandering sits alongside it, only when you choose: find friends, share where you are with the people you pick for as long as you pick, and post Stories that end on their own.

Privacy is enforced on the server, not just hidden in the app, and proven by 400 automated privacy checks. Location sharing keeps only where you are now, never a history. Version 2 is complete and runs as a standalone Android app; it's waiting on its final name and domain before it goes to Google Play.

A route called "The long way to Kyoto": a dashed great-circle arc over a world map joining three numbered waypoints, 11,767 km by air, with "Show the whole route" and "Draw it again".
The Journal: dated Moments in Vienna, such as standing room at the opera and Café Central on a rainy morning, with places and tags, and an "Arrived at Vienna" check-in.
A place card: Visits and Moments with Check in and New Moment buttons, and a History of the place moving from Wishlist to Planned to In progress.
Social map of Lisbon with two friends sharing their location, one live and one approximate
A friend's Story with private reactions and reply

projects.title: Atlantean Gardens
projects.description: Work in progress: the Living Atlas of Atlantean Gardens. Wander seven painted realms, meet the Keepers and collect the strain cards, each tale drawn from the Atlantean Archives.
projects.portfolioDescription: The idea, in development: the story of Atlantean Gardens, bringing love, creativity and joy back to the world of plant medicine, especially cannabis. A plant guide with a real folklore story woven through it, told through painted strain cards, the Atlas and its realms, and the five Keepers. The full immersive experience is being rebuilt.

images.alt: The Living Atlas of Atlantean Gardens: a painted, text-free map of seven realms around a great wisteria tree, with glowing realm names floating above each land.
Inside the Hearthland Realm at dusk, with the riddle panel open listing the strains and Keepers hiding among the bakery, fire circle and Tea & Tales.
Lila found hiding in the Verdant Wild Realm, her portrait card risen from the painting with her whispered message: ‘Pause. Take a slow breath. Look toward the nearest living thing.’

projects.portfolioDescription: A fragrance brand about personal scent. Sweet Vital Nectar makes botanical roll-on perfumes: small, warm and close to the skin.

projects.portfolioDescription: A warm home for growth. IntoTheLighthouse is a human-centred wellbeing and therapy concept, designed to feel welcoming from the first moment, with simplicity and kindness put ahead of clinical distance.
